title: scct.build-plan (mcp.plan arguments)
description: Several bridge ops run as one call (Reloaded.Editor/McpPlanModel.h), what workflow_request op mcp.plan takes. pre: package loads, imports and saves (authoring.apply documents of load/texture/save only, and file ops), which cannot be undone. steps: joinable map edits, all in one Undo step; on any failure the whole step section rolls back (rolledBack: true, failedStep). post: builds, surface texturing, Map Check, saves and screenshots, each on its own; a failure there keeps the steps' changes. Where ops may run follows their bridge policy: reads anywhere; undoable joinable edits in steps (package documents in pre); file ops in pre or post; builds and processes in post; raw commands, undo/redo and nested plans never. Order inside steps: every step that deletes or replaces actors comes before the first step that pastes any (a paste-then-delete Undo crashed the editor). dryRun runs no mutating op and returns preview rows: authoring.apply previews as authoring.preview, stage.apply as stage.preview, other edits as {change, target, note: "runs on apply"}; reads still run. Result: {steps: {id: result}, undo: {steps}, label}.

step.description: At most 256 steps in all; step ids are unique across pre, steps and post.

id.description: Default: the section name plus its 1-based position (pre1, steps2, post1). Later steps bind to it.

op.description: A bridge op with a policy row, such as design.blockbatch, authoring.apply, objectiveplayers.set, ge.add, settings.edit, design.register, mcp.sidecar.set, design.build, mapcheck.run, map.save, view.screenshot.

args.description: The op's arguments (the request is args plus "op"). Any value may be a $bind.

optional.description: post only in effect: record this step's error and carry on.

bind.description: Replaced by the value at ptr (a JSON pointer, empty for the whole result) in the result of an earlier step; binding a step that has not run is an error. Example: {"$bind": {"step": "actors", "ptr": "/identities/ServerTerminal"}}.
